planning_notes: Button on D2 is treated as active-high at the model level: io boolean is true when pressed. If the physical wiring is active-low (pull-down with grounded press, or INPUT_PULLUP with active-low), this would need a model inversion in SysML; no port inversion is applied here.
LM35 temperature is provided via analog_input on A1; conversion to degC is handled in SysML (exact formula/scale factors not specified). Initial analog numeric readings start at 0.

Light sensor is provided via analog_input on A0; any conversion to lux is handled in SysML (not specified), so the serial numeric initially uses f64 with unit adc_count assumption unless SysML overrides reporting units.
Serial baud is 9600 and framing is line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20 as provided.

Text/protocol is not specified for serial output; assumption: the program prints one line per sampling event containing the three typed fields (light, temperature, count) in a consistent order defined in SysML. Update cadence is strictly 'immediately after button press' gated by the serial trigger, not a fixed periodic timer.
Buzzer behavior: on each 5th sample, buzzer D6 'short鸣' is implemented in SysML by driving tone_output with an appropriate frequency and real elapsed-time duration (not in this proposal).
